description: Renders a blind document: a synthetic medical-billing PDF whose footer, title and file names carry only an opaque id, so nothing in it tells a reader which errors were planted. Nothing is saved: the page images, the 835 remittance when asked for and, with include_pdf, the PDF itself come back in the result. The result also returns the id and the PDF's SHA-256, but never the answer key, the scenario or the seed. Call `get_answer_key` with the id to get the key.

also.description: Other documents to render blind with this one: "835" for an X12 835 of the same claims (msn, ppo-eob, hmo-eob, commercial-eob), "bill" for the provider's statement for one claim of the EOB (ppo-eob, hmo-eob, commercial-eob), or a list of both; each file is named by an id.

bill.description: Provider's statement variant when also includes bill, default clean: clean (no error of its own), over-owed (the contractual adjustment is too small, so the balance due is more than the EOB's member share), denied-line-billed (a line the plan denied is billed to the patient), payment-misposted (Paid by Your Plan differs from what the EOB says the plan paid, but the balance due is still right), paid-at-visit (a decoy: the copay paid at the visit shows as received, so the balance due is correctly less than the member share) or over-owed-with-payment (that decoy and the over-owed error together). A variant applies only where the billed claim allows it.

from_page.description: first page to return as an image (default 1)

include_pdf.description: also return the PDF itself, embedded in the result; it counts toward the same size limit as the page images and is left out, with a note, when it alone is over it

layout_variant.description: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.

preset.description: Optional preset for a degraded copy (scan, fax, photo or low-res), which has its own id.

preview.description: pages returned as images: none, the first (from from_page), or all from from_page on, as many as fit in one result (default all)

seed.description: any short string (letters, digits, . _ -); the same seed always gives the same document

type.description: document type: msn, itemized-bill, ppo-eob, hmo-eob, commercial-eob

name: render_blind
title: Render blind document
